layouts.name: Buttonwillow Kart Circuit
layouts.description: The operator's Kart #1 course uses both west and east kart loops: Long Beach, The Glen, Zolder, Daytona, Imola, Monza, the Mulsanne Straight and Monte Carlo triangular return via Spa. The independently visible paved centerline retains those branches and excludes the oval shortcut, hot pits and surrounding main road circuit. Operator route dimensions identify a full course of roughly 952 m; mapping is not scaled to that distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1025.0 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
